errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като "Val Score"
errors.evidence: The y-axis is not labeled. "Val Score" is the title of the chart.
The y-axis range shown in the figure is from -1.0 to 0.4.

errors.text_span: Стойностите са маркирани с интервали от 0.04
errors.evidence: The major tick marks on the y-axis are at intervals of 0.2, not 0.04.
The line for "Tool-Star(3B) w/o mask" is orange, not red.

errors.text_span: Линията започва от 0 на оста Y
errors.evidence: The orange line ("Tool-Star(3B) w/o mask") starts at a y-value of approximately 0.38, not 0.

errors.text_span: свежда стойността си до приблизително -1.0 на оста X
errors.evidence: The value of -1.0 is reached on the Y-axis, not the X-axis.

errors.text_span: След това линията се връща към 0 на оста Y и запазва тази стойност до 35 на оста X.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. After dropping to -1.0 at Step 10, the orange line remains flat at -1.0 until the end of the graph (Step 40). It does not return to 0.
The line for "Tool-Star(3B)" is blue, not black.

errors.text_span: Линията започва от 0 на оста Y и запазва тази стойност през целия интервал от 0 до 35 на оста X.
errors.evidence: This description of the blue line is completely incorrect. The line starts at a y-value of approximately 0.38 (not 0) and has a slight upward trend with fluctuations; it is not a flat line at 0.
The x-axis has evenly spaced ticks (0, 5, 10, 15...), which indicates a linear scale, not a logarithmic one.
The blue line, representing 'Tool-Star(3B)', starts at a Val Score of approximately +0.38, not -0.8.
The blue line ends at Step 40 with a Val Score of approximately 0.48, not 0.4.
The orange line, representing 'Tool-Star(3B) w/o mask', starts at a Val Score of approximately +0.38, not -1.0. It drops to -1.0 later.
The orange line drops to -1.0 by Step 10 and remains at -1.0 for the rest of the steps. It never reaches -0.2.
The description omits the tick mark intervals for the x-axis (every 5 steps) and the y-axis (every 0.2 units).

The description fails to mention that both lines are solid. More importantly, it does not describe the sharp drop of the orange line between step 0 and 10, or the subsequent flat trend at y=-1.0 from step 10 to 40, which are the most prominent features of that line.
The word 'andando' is not a German word and makes the sentence describing the x-axis nonsensical.

errors.text_span: ist in Einheiten der Val-Score korreliert
errors.evidence: This is an awkward and grammatically incorrect way to describe the y-axis. A clearer phrasing would be 'stellt den Val-Score dar' (represents the Val Score).
